title: Beyond Benchmarks: Exposing the Hidden Crisis in Bangla Hate Speech Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating Bangla hate speech detection models for their ability to generalize to implicit hate, sarcasm, and emoji-laden expressions in real-world environments. While it discusses the ethical implications of content moderation (such as over-policing legitimate speech) and utilizes datasets that contain categories like religious hate, it does not explicitly study, evaluate, or benchmark religion, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks within LLMs.
